forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: まぶしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to coat; to sprinkle over; to cover with
definitions.explanation: To coat the surface of food with powder, flour, breadcrumbs, or other dry ingredients by tossing or rolling. Primarily a cooking term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶす。
⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶして⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Coat the chicken in flour before frying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧きな{粉|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧まぶして⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like eating dango generously coated with kinako (roasted soybean flour).

notes:
まぶす means to coat the surface of food evenly with a powdery or granular ingredient by tossing or rolling.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Particle pattern: A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶす (coat A with B)
- No standard intransitive pair.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶす (coat the meat with flour)
- ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧きな{粉|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶす (coat mochi with roasted soybean flour)
- ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶす (coat chicken with potato starch)
- ⟦パン{粉|こ}→パン粉：04926_panko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まぶして⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧ (coat with breadcrumbs and deep-fry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}りかける→振りかける：21485_furikakeru⟧: to sprinkle on top (does not imply full coverage; the ingredient just sits on the surface).
- まぶす specifically implies coating the entire surface evenly, usually by tossing, rolling, or shaking the food in the ingredient.

REGISTER:
- Almost exclusively used in cooking contexts; appears constantly in recipes and food shows.
